# Copp

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P54](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0054)</sub>

## Appearance

[Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp is a small person who dresses in shabby black garments. Her attire includes a hat selected for its durability and wearability rather than for vain adornment.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

## History

Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp hosted [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) for tea and bread after [Anne](../character/anne.md) apologized for looking into her pantry. During their visit, Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) shared the news that she was getting married. She also successfully negotiated the sale of her willow-ware platter to [Anne](../character/anne.md).

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P66](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0066), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P67](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0067)_
